verdict: No paid campaigns running; organic reach is your only active signal.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals — there was zero paid spend this period, meaning no paid leads were generated. Combined organic activity from Google Business Profiles totalled 396 actions (82 + 108 + 206) over the last 28 days, but search clicks and website sessions trended down in the most recent week across Forte and O'Hare, and Advance Grinding's site sessions fell 44% week-over-week despite a GBP spike. Two O'Hare profiles — Precision Ground Bars and Precision Ground Metals — recorded zero calls despite receiving impressions, and call-to-impression rates across all profiles remain very low; we are auditing the listings and call-to-action setup on those profiles now. As paid campaigns are reactivated, you should expect lead volume and cost-per-lead figures to return as the primary performance measures.

organic search clicks to O'Hare Precision Metals this period — the strongest search presence across all entities

watch_item.issue: Two O'Hare GBP profiles (Precision Ground Bars and Precision Ground Metals) received impressions this period but generated zero calls, and call rates are low across all profiles.
watch_item.fix: We are reviewing the call button setup, listing accuracy, and contact prompts on all profiles to remove any friction preventing searchers from calling.
